top_story: Tehran’s March warning of regional escalation after Trump threatened Iran’s power infrastructure reinforced a baseline of coercive brinkmanship around the Gulf, keeping energy security and maritime access politically charged across the region. In the Levant, Israel’s 12 May approval of a record number of West Bank settlements deepens a separate but connected pattern of hardening unilateralism, accelerating Palestinian land loss and worsening conditions for civilian life under occupation.
